jobs.program: Summer Clerkship — 2027 NSW Clerkship Recruitment Program cycle (clerkships over summer 2027/28)
jobs.notes: Applications open 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027; the Law Society publishes two staggered closing dates (Sun 4 July and Sun 11 July 2027, 11:59pm AEST) depending on the employer, so a single confirmed close date cannot be given — offers can be made from 9:00am Wed 8 Sept 2027 and must be accepted/declined by 1:00pm Thu 9 Sept 2027; eligibility is penultimate-year students.
